proof_body:
by
  intro f g hf hg mf mg gf fg h0
  have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by
    have := gf 0 (by simp)
    rwa [h0] at this
  have cl : ∀ {h : ℂ → ℂ}, Set.MapsTo h (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) → Set.MapsTo h (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) := fun hm x hx => Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hm hx)
  by_cases hex : ∃ a ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, a ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hne⟩ := hex
    have ha' : ‖a‖ < 1 := by simpa using ha
    have h1 : ‖f a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := Complex.norm_le_norm_of_mapsTo_ball hf (cl mf) h0 ha'
    have h2 : ‖g (f a)‖ ≤ ‖f a‖ := Complex.norm_le_norm_of_mapsTo_ball hg (cl mg) hg0 (by simpa using mf ha)
    rw [gf a ha] at h2
    have hn : ‖f a‖ = ‖a‖ := le_antisymm h1 h2
    have hm : Set.MapsTo f (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.closedBall (f 0) (1 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [h0]; exact cl mf
    have hs : ‖dslope f 0 a‖ = (1 : ℝ) / 1 := by
      rw [dslope_of_ne f hne, slope_def_module, h0]
      simp only [sub_zero, norm_smul, norm_inv, hn]
      field_simp [norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hne]
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hEq⟩ := Complex.affine_of_mapsTo_ball_of_exists_norm_dslope_eq_div' hf hm ⟨a, ha, hs⟩
    refine ⟨C, by simpa using hC, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have := hEq hz
    simpa [h0, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using this
  · exfalso
    exact hex ⟨1 / 2, by simp; norm_num, by norm_num⟩
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 1) → DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball 0 1) → Set.MapsTo f (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) → Set.MapsTo g (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, g (f z) = z) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, f (g z) = z) → f 0 = 0 → ∃ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, f z = u * z
